messages:
Maria Chen: quick sync — i updated the pricing FAQ microcopy + calculator routing after the webinar, want quick eyes before i push. main goal: reduce inbound noise to sales while keeping high-intent leads routed correctly :wave:
Ben Patel: can you paste the new copy here? i can scan now.
Maria Chen: sure. gist: short Q/A, emphasize 'predictable unit costs' and add a line under each tier: 'best for X use cases'. also changed the CTA on the calculator from 'Contact sales' -> 'Get pricing tailored to you' for >1M tokens.
Kevin O'Neil: i like the CTA tweak. for routing rules, let's be explicit. current idea:
```
// routing rules (pseudocode)
if (monthly_tokens >= 1000000) route = 'sales-high-intent';
else if (company_size == 'enterprise' || has_compliance == true) route = 'enterprise-ps';
else route = 'self-serve';
```
Maria Chen: that's the version i put in staging. sophia — design tweaks to the calculator microcopy?
Sophia Ruiz: small ask: please shorten text under the result card. users skim. propose: 'Estimated monthly spend — includes batching & caching savings'. also can we add microcopy beneath the CTA: 'Typical response in < 200ms for small requests' — is that safe?
Kevin O'Neil: i'd be careful with hard latency claims on the public page. maybe 'low-latency options available' instead.
Oliver Grant: from sales POV, routing should flag 'interest_level' if user toggles 'need SLA' or selects 'private deployment' in the form. then we show a quick survey before handing off. reduces bad leads.
Maria Chen: good call. i'll add a boolean `needs_sla` to the form and route those to enterprise. also adding a one-question micro-survey after results: 'Are you evaluating for a production app?' yes/no.
Ben Patel: for A/B testing, let's run two microcopy variants for the FAQ answer about committed capacity:
- variant A: 'Reserved capacity helps you get predictable throughput and unit economics.'
- variant B: 'Reserve GPU capacity to lower per-token cost and guarantee throughput.'
Sophia Ruiz: visuals for A/B are identical; only copy changes. we can ship both.
Maria Chen: timeline: push to staging today, QA tomorrow, soft-launch to 10% of traffic on monday, funnel metrics review wednesday. @deploy-bot — deploy staging build 176999-s1 when tests pass. :rocket:
deploy-bot: deployment 176999-s1 started — staging — Maria Chen requested — logs: https://ci.internal/176999-s1
Oliver Grant: can we add a small hidden field for 'lead_source' in the calculator so we know if users came from webinar vs benchmark page? helps routing and follow-up messaging.
Maria Chen: done, tracking param added. last thing — any objection to the 'Get pricing tailored to you' CTA for >1M tokens?
Ben Patel: no objections. sounds less salesy than 'contact sales'.
Kevin O'Neil: good. i'll update the rollout doc with the routing pseudocode and dashboards to monitor (calc->leads conversion, route accuracy).
Maria Chen: perfect. i'll merge and ping ops for the 10% rollout Monday. thanks everyone :tada:
